optionalTwelveEqualFamilyWeights.scope: Explicit equal-family union of two distinct six-family campaigns; not a replacement for either primary denominator. Narrow stability observations are excluded.

limits: These are B1-emitted C program runtimes after Clang compilation, not B1/B2 compiler request time. Summary retains every interval including unfavorable samples. Three primary rounds per role and finite fixed workloads do not establish universal parity. Raw reports and plans remain authoritative; this portable summary pins them and carries their timing/correctness observations. No release installation or later compiler variant is measured by this checkpoint.
